description: This file is a Perl script designed to start and configure an SSH server for testing purposes, including generating keys, creating configuration files for the SSH daemon and client, and handling server process management in various environments (Windows and Unix-like). It includes detailed configuration setup, version checks, and environment-specific path handling for the SSH server and client components.

methods.name: pp
methods.description: Constructs the path in the server's log directory for a given filename, based on the directory stored in $piddir.

methods.name: sshd_supports_opt
methods.description: Checks if the current SSH daemon supports a specific command-line option with a given value, by testing the configuration.
